name: PP1 Mathematical Activities Term 1 Exam
subject: Mathematical Activities
instructions: Answer ALL questions. Your teacher will read the questions aloud. Count the objects, then circle or write the correct answer.

items.question: Count the apples in the picture: 1, 2, 3. How many apples are there?
Count the balls: 1, 2, 3, 4, 5. How many balls?
Which of these is the number 2? (look at the number cards)

sections.heading: Section B: Written Questions (16 marks)
items: 1. Count and write the number of cups in the picture. (2 marks)
2. Write the numbers 1 to 5 in order. (5 marks)
4. Match: two hands have ___ fingers. Write the number. (1 mark)
5. Which is more, 3 or 5? Write the bigger number. (1 mark)
6. Count backwards from 5 to 1 and write the numbers. (5 marks)
